name: Sheru Bhai AI
tagline: Create photos and videos with a fictional white lion character.
description: Sheru Bhai AI helps creators make photo and video scenes featuring Sheru, a fictional white lion. Choose a companion scene, transform a photo into a lion character, or make a character-only scene. Signed-in users select a scene and settings before generating; results can be previewed and downloaded while available. Generation uses credits purchased in one-time packs starting at $6.99. A sample workflow is illustrative. https://sheru-bhai.app/
